body.x: Samsung(www.samsung.com) announced 'Motion Sync upright vacuum cleaner' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

It is an additional premium solution to consumers' floor care needs with its new VU12F40 Motion Sync upright vacuum cleaner. The VU12F40 features an innovative Full Detachable Handheld vacuum that can be completely detached from the main body to allow consumers to easily clean hard to reach places. The handheld vacuum has its own motor for ultimate portability. Also, the vacuum features CycloneForce multi™ Technology: 9-Cyclonic chambers that keep fine dust and debris from the filters to offer powerful suction and performance. With Motion Sync Design, a swivel brush and large, reverse-cambered wheels offer maximum steer-ability to smoothly tackle corners and sharp turns.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
